prs.title: fix(shared): preserve MCPError payload on pickle
prs.author: MukundaKatta
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both fix the same underlying defect: MCPError-family exceptions (specifically UrlElicitationRequiredError, refs #2431) are unpicklable because the default Exception.__reduce_ex__ reconstructs via `cls(*self.args)`, and `self.args` is set by MCPError.__init__ to `(code, message, data)` — which doesn't match UrlElicitationRequiredError's actual constructor signature `(elicitations, message=None)`, raising a TypeError on every unpickle. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both fix the same underlying defect: MCPError-family exceptions (specifically UrlElicitationRequiredError, refs #2431) are unpicklable because the default Exception.__reduce_ex__ reconstructs via `cls(*self.args)`, and `self.args` is set by MCPError.__init__ to `(code, message, data)` — which doesn't match UrlElicitationRequiredError's actual constructor signature `(elicitations, message=None)`, raising a TypeError on every unpickle. prs.cluster_pick_reason: 2478 fixes the root cause generically at the MCPError base via a `_restore_mcp_error` dispatch helper: it reconstructs any MCPError subclass through `from_error_data` by default, special-casing only `UrlElicitationRequiredError` (via `from_error`) because that subclass interprets `error.data` as a typed elicitations list rather than free-form data. This covers every current and future MCPError subclass with a non-matching constructor, not just the one named in #2431. 2555's `__reduce__` override lives only on `UrlElicitationRequiredError` and would take precedence over any base-class `__reduce__` from 2478 due to MRO, making its special-case branch in `_restore_mcp_error` dead code if both land — i.e. the two PRs implement competing reconstruction paths for the same class. 2555's diff does add explicit pickle round-trip tests in tests/shared/test_exceptions.py that 2478's shown diff lacks; those tests should be ported onto 2478 before merging so the generic fix keeps regression coverage for the exact scenario in #2431.

prs.cluster_pick_reason: 3056 adds `_unwrap_annotated`, so the fix also applies to `Annotated[str | None, Field(...)]` parameters (the common pattern for documented tool params); 2032's `_should_pre_parse_json` only special-cases `Union` origins directly, so an `Annotated`-wrapped union falls through to the 'should parse' branch and remains broken. 3056 also scopes the skip strictly to `str | None`/`Optional[str]`, leaving pre-parsing behavior for other unions (e.g. `str | int`, `str | list[str]`) untouched, whereas 2032's `_SIMPLE_TYPES` check broadens the skip to any union composed only of str/int/float/bool/None — a wider behavior change beyond the reported corruption bug and not covered by the shown test diff.
